narration.full_text: Control and coordination is the process by which different activities of an organism are regulated and integrated so that it can respond properly to internal and external stimuli. Living organisms perform many activities at the same time. These activities must be controlled and coordinated to maintain balance and survival. All living organisms respond and react to changes in the environment around them. The changes in the environment to which organisms respond and react are called stimuli, such as light, heat, cold, smell, touch, etc. Both plants and animals respond to stimuli, but in a different manner. In animals, control and coordination is brought about with the help of two main systems: the Nervous system and the Endocrine system.
